class.name: PorchlightProgress
class.brief_description: Stores and persists completed Porchlight milestones.
class.description: The global Porchlight milestone-state service. Completed milestones are stored persistently in completion order and automatically loaded when the singleton is created. Milestone names are normalized by removing leading and trailing whitespace. Use [method complete_milestone] and [method remove_milestone] for individual changes. Use [method complete_milestones] and [method remove_milestones] to apply an ordered batch with one save operation. Progress is stored at [code]user://porchlight_progress.cfg[/code].

method.name: clear_milestones
method.description: Removes every completed milestone and saves the empty progress state. Emits [signal milestones_cleared] if at least one milestone was completed before the operation.

method.name: complete_milestone
method.description: Marks [param milestone] as complete and saves the updated progress. Returns [code]true[/code] if the milestone was newly completed. Returns [code]false[/code] if its normalized name is empty or it was already complete. A newly completed milestone is appended to the ordered list returned by [method get_completed_milestones] and causes [signal milestone_completed] to be emitted.

method.name: complete_milestones
method.description: Marks every normalized entry in [param milestones] as complete. Leading and trailing whitespace is removed, empty entries are ignored, and duplicate names are discarded while preserving their first occurrence. Returns the milestones that became newly complete, in normalized input order. Milestones that were already complete are omitted from the returned array. The full batch is applied before signals are emitted. Progress is saved once when at least one milestone changes, then [signal milestone_completed] is emitted once for each returned milestone in order. Returns an empty array without saving or emitting signals when no milestone changes.

method.name: get_completed_count
method.description: Returns the number of currently completed milestones.

method.name: get_completed_milestones
method.description: Returns the completed milestones as an [Array] of [StringName] values. The milestones are returned in the order they were completed or loaded from the save file.

method.name: is_complete
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param milestone] is currently complete. Returns [code]false[/code] when the normalized milestone name is empty.

method.name: load_progress
method.description: Reloads completed milestones from the progress save file. Returns [constant OK] when loading succeeds. A missing save file is treated as empty progress and also returns [constant OK]. Empty entries, unsupported entry types, and duplicate milestone names inside an otherwise valid milestone array are ignored.

method.name: remove_milestone
method.description: Removes [param milestone] from completed progress and saves the updated state. Returns [code]true[/code] if the milestone was removed. Returns [code]false[/code] if its normalized name is empty or it was not complete. A successful removal emits [signal milestone_removed].

method.name: remove_milestones
method.description: Removes every normalized entry in [param milestones] from completed progress. Leading and trailing whitespace is removed, empty entries are ignored, and duplicate names are discarded while preserving their first occurrence. Returns the milestones that were actually removed, in normalized input order. Milestones that were not complete are omitted from the returned array. The full batch is applied before signals are emitted. Progress is saved once when at least one milestone changes, then [signal milestone_removed] is emitted once for each returned milestone in order. Returns an empty array without saving or emitting signals when no milestone changes.

method.name: save_progress
method.description: Writes the current ordered milestone list to the progress save file. Returns the resulting [enum Error] value.

signal.name: milestone_completed
signal.description: Emitted when [param milestone] becomes complete. Batch completion emits this signal once per changed milestone, after the entire batch has been applied and saved.

signal.name: milestone_removed
signal.description: Emitted when [param milestone] is removed from completed progress. Batch removal emits this signal once per changed milestone, after the entire batch has been applied and saved.

signal.name: milestones_cleared
signal.description: Emitted when [method clear_milestones] removes one or more completed milestones.
